quirks.summary: The URL slug 'pcnpa' is NOT the tenant code - x-client must be PEMBROKESHIRECOAST.
quirks.detail: Resolve the code from the identity service (/api/client/get?url=pcnpa) instead of deriving it from the slug.

quirks.summary: This tenant's DMS switch is SHAREPOINT, so documents come from the Agile API itself - no council-hosted DMS is involved.
quirks.detail: Contrast the sibling tenant Pembrokeshire County Council, where DMS=EXTERNAL sends documents to a separate council host.
